title: identifier darker than footer
rule: Identifier darker than the footer (grade 80+ / black). Primary or base family, darker than the preceding section, anchored at the bottom so it is not another footer stripe.
pass_when: Identifier is darker than the preceding footer section (primary/base grade 80+ or black) and sits at the bottom.
fail_when: Identifier matches the footer stripe or sits mid-page as another footer band.
overview: The identifier sits at the bottom darker than the preceding footer section.
apply_when: Styling the USWDS identifier beneath a site footer on government pages.
not_when: Matching the footer stripe or placing the identifier mid-page as another band.
agent_hint: Make the identifier darker than the footer (grade 80+/black) and anchor it at the bottom.
description: USWDS identifiers use primary or base family colour darker than the preceding footer section (grade 80+ or black) and sit at the bottom so they are not another footer stripe. Matching the footer band or placing the identifier mid-page as an extra stripe fails the hierarchy. Keep the identifier darker and bottom-anchored so agency identity reads as the final band.
do_not_claim: Required-links placement as this colour row.
